dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Little Smoky area (NTS 83K/NW) (GIS data, line features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the line features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 564, Surficial Geology of the Little Smoky Area (NTS 83K/NW).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Little Smoky Area (NTS 83K/NW) (GIS data, line features)
